correctness.rationale: For primitive period two U²σ=σ≠Uσ, the two-step graph Laplacian forces every vertex to fire exactly once; a first-phase cut S gives exactly k_v(S) legal chip values at vertex v. Therefore N₂(G)=Σ_S∏_v k_v(S). On trees crossing-edge bits are independent up to two complementary vertex phases, and switching product sum yields N₂(T)=Σ_{neighbor maps f}2^{c(f)}, c(f) components of doubled-edge map. Every edge gives one component map, yielding N₂≥2(n−1), with extra maps iff tree contains two disjoint edges, i.e. is not a star. Rooted recurrence A=Σ_i b_i∏_{j≠i}(a_j+b_j), B=A+∏_i(a_i+b_i) and strict Pell identities show merging branches preserves A but strictly increases B. Thus N₂≤2P_{n−1} with equality only paths for n≥4; stars unique lower. Independently evaluated exact cut weight for all nonisomorphic trees through n=8; no finite-only inference.
